---
title: "hpc-setup"
---

Installs bioinformatic tools and their full software stack into **one directory**,
**without root**, on Linux (Debian/Ubuntu/RHEL/Fedora, `x86_64`).
Every package is available as an [Lmod](https://lmod.readthedocs.io) module.

```bash
mkdir ~/hpc && cd ~/hpc
wget -qO- https://github.com/nucbio/hpc-setup/raw/main/boot.sh | bash
```

What gets installed:

1. **Core libraries**: zlib, openssl, libcurl, cairo, glib, ImageMagick, pandoc, ...
2. **Languages**: R, Python, Rust, Java, Lua
3. **Bioinformatic tools**: samtools, bowtie2, STAR, gatk, dorado, modkit, ...
4. **Terminal tools**: nvim, git, bat, eza, fd, ripgrep, tree, zoxide

Full list with versions: [Packages](packages.qmd).
